conclusion: The repository supports a narrow, pipeline-dependent observational decoding result and reproducible factorial activation geometry, but it does not support a causal evaluation-awareness mechanism claim. The preregistered causal experiment is unusable because both model runs failed the unchanged per-row baseline reproduction gate before a complete response surface existed. Partial intervention records are excluded wholesale and were not analyzed.

estimator_reversal.claim: At normalized depth q=0.375, the aggregate mixed-minus-best-specialist AUC effect is +0.00904956 for L2 logistic (95% common-block bootstrap CI [0.007981, 0.010120]) and -0.00430404 for paired diagonal LDA (CI [-0.005278, -0.003340]); this is pipeline-dependent observational stated-purpose decoding, not independent confirmation or causality.
mandatory_caveats: The logistic analysis was a targeted post-comparator chosen after inspecting the paired diagonal-LDA result and a loose 8B precursor.
Only the fixed normalized depth q=0.375 was tested; this is not a layer trajectory.
The panel contains three fixed, related Llama checkpoints and reuses the same assignment seeds across checkpoints.
The endpoint is observational stated-purpose decoding, not semantic correctness, behavior, evaluation awareness, or a causal mechanism.

environment_matched_geometry.interpretation: Purpose, format, and purpose-by-format structure is measurable in the frozen pilot bank. This is representation geometry, not evidence that the geometry causally controls model behavior or evaluation awareness.

causal_validation.why_no_retry: Relaxing the gate, selecting only passing layers, or analyzing partial records after these failures would be post-outcome protocol adaptation. The project rules prohibit all three.

allowed: Environment-matched factorial representation geometry on the frozen pilot bank
A documented failed causal reproducibility gate
prohibited: Behavioral steering or internal causal mediation
Analysis of either partial causal raw file

stop_reason: Reasonable technical recovery was exhausted: exact archive verification, H100 and A100 baseline retries, batch-one environment-matched all-layer re-extraction, frozen geometry rebuilding, immutable plan rebuilding, and same-H100 causal execution. Both models still violated the preregistered high-layer reproduction gate. No scientifically valid causal run remains reachable without changing the failed gate.
